items.headline: Carrick wins first match as permanent United manager with 5-0 rout of Rosenborg
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly in Norway. Carrick's side showed convincing display with strong individual performances after opening defeat to Wrexham.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko sidelined with shin injury during pre-season preparations
items.summary: Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko unavailable for Rosenborg match due to shin injury. Goalkeeper Karl Darlow also recovering from minor surgery.
